goals.title: Strengthen voice interruption invariants
goals.goal: Improve internal voice-runtime interruption and race safety. Verify cancellation state, stale result suppression and non-regression of LISTENING and WORKING. Do not claim real model/TTS cancellation unless backed by a real provider adapter. Preserve audio ownership.
goals.problem_evidence: Owner-requested True Interruption V2; the open PR #37 owns voice-runtime changes, so this goal must be deferred automatically while its files remain in an open PR.
goals.expected_improvement: Add a deterministic regression for a voice-runtime cancellation race without changing provider, microphone, approval, or user data behavior.
goals.test_scope: The new isolated voice interruption test plus syntax compilation; full backend regression remains an independent PR check.
success_criteria: Existing voice runtime state invariants remain covered
No claim of real provider/TTS cancellation from synthetic tests

goals.title: Strengthen conversation interruption continuity
goals.goal: Improve bounded communication-state handling for interruptions and resumed turns, with deterministic regression tests. Do not change user data storage, device permissions, routing, security or microphone ownership.
goals.problem_evidence: Owner-requested Natural Conversation V5 requires preserving context after a user interrupts; the bounded communication state is a directly testable low-risk target.
goals.expected_improvement: Make interrupted and resumed dialogue state deterministic across short conversation sequences.
goals.test_scope: The new isolated communication regression test plus syntax compilation; no model or device inference is implied.
success_criteria: A stopped turn does not overwrite a newer turn
Resumption retains only the same thread context
No cross-user or cross-conversation state is introduced
